rationale: The target faithfully separates the source's context-dependent notation into six explicit definition equivalences: global and eventual forms of two-sided comparison, upper comparison, and lower comparison. Constants are strictly positive, existentially chosen outside the argument scope, and therefore uniform. Global validity uses ∀ n, while sufficiently-large validity uses Eventually atTop on Nat.
